rows.ARS:
Orange blend Floribunda.
Registration name: BARdern
rows.Bloom: Orange, red shading. None to mild fragrance. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Bronze-green, dense foliage.

Height: 2' to 32" (60 to 80cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Rose Barni says Tempi Moderni was awarded as the best Italian Roses at Monza in 1996. The flaming colors of this rose are difficult to describe. From bud to open flowers, the color changes from golden-yellow to orange-vermilion and all sorts of shades in between...
Internal breeder code: 3905. Participated in the 1996 Monza Competition (Source: Website Roseto Niso Fumagalli).
